concepts.name: Cell Structure
concepts.subject: biology
concepts.description: The organelles and structures of prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells.
learning_objectives: Identify the major organelles of a eukaryotic cell and describe their functions.

concepts.name: Membrane Transport
concepts.subject: biology
concepts.description: Passive and active transport of substances across the cell membrane.
learning_objectives: Distinguish between passive and active transport mechanisms.

concepts.name: Biomolecules
concepts.subject: biology
concepts.description: The structure and function of carbohydrates, lipids, proteins, and nucleic acids.
learning_objectives: Relate the structure of each major biomolecule class to its biological function.

concepts.name: Cellular Respiration
concepts.subject: biology
concepts.description: How cells convert glucose into usable chemical energy (ATP).
learning_objectives: Trace the flow of electrons and energy through cellular respiration.

concepts.name: Photosynthesis
concepts.subject: biology
concepts.description: How plants convert light energy into chemical energy.
learning_objectives: Describe the light-dependent and light-independent reactions of photosynthesis.

concepts.name: DNA Structure
concepts.subject: biology
concepts.description: The double helix structure of DNA and its role as genetic material.
learning_objectives: Describe the structure of DNA and explain how it encodes genetic information.

concepts.name: DNA Replication
concepts.subject: biology
concepts.description: How DNA is copied prior to cell division.
learning_objectives: Describe the semiconservative mechanism of DNA replication.

concepts.name: Gene Expression
concepts.subject: biology
concepts.description: Transcription and translation, the process of turning genes into proteins.
learning_objectives: Trace the flow of genetic information from DNA through mRNA to protein.

concepts.name: Mendelian Genetics
concepts.subject: biology
concepts.description: Patterns of inheritance discovered by Gregor Mendel.
learning_objectives: Apply Punnett squares to predict inheritance patterns for simple traits.

concepts.name: Population Genetics
concepts.subject: biology
concepts.description: How allele frequencies change in populations over time.
learning_objectives: Apply the Hardy-Weinberg principle to compute allele and genotype frequencies.

concepts.name: Natural Selection
concepts.subject: biology
concepts.description: The mechanism by which populations evolve over generations.
learning_objectives: Explain how natural selection acts on heritable variation within a population.

concepts.name: Homeostasis
concepts.subject: biology
concepts.description: How organisms maintain a stable internal environment.
learning_objectives: Describe feedback mechanisms that maintain physiological homeostasis.

concepts.name: Introduction to Human Physiology
concepts.subject: biology
concepts.description: An overview of the major organ systems and how they interact.
learning_objectives: Describe how the major organ systems work together to maintain body function.

concepts.name: Ecology Basics
concepts.subject: biology
concepts.description: Populations, communities, and energy flow through ecosystems.
learning_objectives: Describe energy flow and nutrient cycling within an ecosystem.
